name: Furnace Stokers
teaches: kick Stoke Core, or each Thrall bursts in slag where it dies
chainNote: Chain with Bellows Shift: five Stoke Cores, two Fan the Coals and a Bronze Ward cast inside one pull. Three kickers cannot stop them all: kick the Ward and the Tenders, then drag every Overheated Thrall out of the group before it dies.
